title: Material Blend 3-Mix Trio #03 (부채꼴·물결 / 동심원·매끈 / 대각 띠·매끈 | 스테인드글라스+목재+흑요암금 / 나비날개비늘+뱀비늘+코이비늘 / 목재+드래곤비늘+인어비늘)
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. THREE women standing side by side, each with her own multi-material blended body.

#1: THE ABSOLUTE DARKEST BLACK SKIN ON EARTH blue-black void complexion darker than night sky, mid 40s goddess, powerlifter bombshell physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — immense powerful thighs and shoulders built with real strength, a thick solid waist, overwhelming muscular bulk layered with soft curves everywhere, loose beach waves mid-length tousled — her body carries 3 different materials at once, each claiming its own region of her figure. Her figure is divided into 3 wedge-shaped regions radiating from a single centre point located about 54% of the way down her figure from the top on the centre line of her figure. 3 hazy ray-shaped transition zones leave that centre pointing toward 9 o'clock, 3 o'clock and 6 o'clock as seen by the camera, where 12 o'clock points straight up. Region 1 is the wedge between the 9 o'clock ray and the 3 o'clock ray, sweeping clockwise: it carries solid thick stained glass fused to her form, hundreds of small individual panes each no larger than a coin, BLAZING ELECTRIC MAGENTA and VIVID SILVER panes alternating in a dense irregular mosaic, dark lead-line seams webbing between every pane. Region 2 is the wedge between the 3 o'clock ray and the 6 o'clock ray, sweeping clockwise: it carries deep black ebony wood fused directly into her own form, natural fine grain lines flowing to follow every curve, BLAZING glossy jet-black grain with VIVID dark-brown highlight streaks. Region 3 is the wedge between the 6 o'clock ray and the 9 o'clock ray, sweeping clockwise: it carries polished obsidian stone fused directly to her own form, solid glossy black stone curving to follow her body's true shape, with molten gold seams running between fitted stone sections. The boundaries between regions are hazy and feathered — there is no visible line at all. Each transition zone is about a hand's width wide, and across it the neighbouring materials dissolve into each other, elements from one thinning out as elements from the other appear, density fading rather than stopping abruptly, never a hard edge. Each transition zone follows a gently undulating wave, rising and falling softly, rather than a straight course. Even inside a transition zone the skin is never left bare: at every point one material, or a mixture of the two, fully covers it, no fabric no seam no garment anywhere, every material fused to or erupting from her own living skin, covering her completely with no bare skin anywhere from neck to ankle. Pose: strong hip pop left, both hands pressing outer hips outward arching back to extreme, every region clearly visible to the camera — most extreme powerlifter bombshell silhouette ever displayed.
#1: extreme platform heels/boots blending the relevant materials at her feet, extra long nails each matching whichever region that hand falls in.
